registered: 2026-11-08, before any split of these minutes by position in the range
operator: Bisect the high and the low. Enter only between the midpoint and the low.
why_this_is_new: The between-levels rule was scored once and failed as a skip-everything filter (docs/studies/FLAT_CONJUNCTION_2026-11-08.md). That read did not record where in the range the price sat. The forward range-position logger is a different question: desk entries, top fifth, rs_pos30 >= 0.80, and it has not been read. This cut is the midpoint of the same 15-bar high and low the sideways rule already uses.
already_seen: The pooled sideways means on this window were seen before this registration. They are not a target and they do not move the midpoint. No position split has been computed.

code.levels: ai_entry_watch._range_shape_fields. The high and the low are the last 15 closed bars, with the passed price included. rs_pos15 is 0 at the low and 1 at the high.
code.sideways: tools/studies/flat_conjunction.is_sideways, thresholds unchanged: range >= 20 bp, rs_er15 <= 0.30, abs(rise) <= half the range, fast %R span >= 15 with net <= half the span, wr_d10_slow <= 0.
code.feed: IEX. The same live functions. A minute the functions refuse is dropped.

entry_rule.range: The minute must be sideways under the frozen rule. That is the high and the low being bisected. A minute at the high often fails that rule because the slow line is rising. Those minutes stay out. The slope leg is not removed.
entry_rule.lower_half: rs_pos15 <= 0.5. This includes the midpoint and the low.
entry_rule.upper_half: sideways and rs_pos15 > 0.5. This is the control half, not an entry.
entry_rule.frozen: 0.5 was the operator's bisect. It is not fit. No other cut is tried.

score_window: The same window as the parent read: every IEX warehouse session through 2026-09-23 inclusive. Two warmup sessions are not scored. Days after 2026-09-23 are not scored.
sampling: Same grid as the parent: top 40 names by the prior session's IEX dollar volume, first open >= $20, decisions 10:00 to 15:50 ET every 5 minutes. Forward is the next 5 minutes.

outcome.gross_bp: close five minutes ahead versus the last close the live function could see
outcome.never_green: no high in the next 5 bars reaches that close * 1.0005

questions.SEPARATES: mean gross of the lower half minus mean gross of the upper half > 0 in BOTH date halves, day-clustered t >= 1.96, and the same sign after clipping the top 1% of gross. The lower half must also sit above the unconditional mean of every scored minute in both halves. That second comparison only has to point the same way.
questions.PROFITABLE: SEPARATES, and the lower-half net > 0 in both halves at 4 bp and at 8 bp, and the day-bootstrap 5th percentile of (lower-half mean minus all-minute mean) > 0, and that bootstrap median beats a random skip of the same count per day.

power: Each half needs >= 20 days with at least 5 lower-half and 5 upper-half minutes, and >= 200 lower-half minutes. Otherwise UNDERPOWERED. The thresholds are not loosened after seeing the share.
desk_information: Watch-path entries on 2026-11-02..2026-11-06, same live functions. Five sessions. INFORMATION only.
canary: tests/test_range_bisect.py. A price at the low of a live oscillation is an entry. A price at the high is not. A planted gap on the lower half must SEPARATE. A zero plant must not be PROFITABLE.
if_pass: Not a live gate. A positive still needs a result-skeptic review. Same-name later-only is not in this read.
if_fail: Close. Do not move 0.5 or any sideways threshold.
